page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.large is an x86_64 general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 2 vCPUs derived from 1 dedicated physical core using hyper-threading, paired with 8.0 GB of system memory for a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio. The instance includes 35 MB of L3 cache and supports instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512F, and AES. There is no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence, and no GPU hardware is included. Networking operates with a 1 Gbps baseline under the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data reflects the older Broadwell-generation architecture, placing processing capacity in the lower performance tiers. The instance achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1092.58 and a multi-core score of 1442.69. In Geekbench testing, it recorded 913.0 for single-core execution and 1083.0 for multi-core. Memory throughput measures 10.65 GB/s for uncached large-block reads and 9.53 GB/s for writes, complemented by a PassMark memory score of 967.63. Single-threaded gzip compression scored 18.72 GB/s, while single-threaded bzip3 decompression reached 7.36 GB/s.

Operational throughput tests show the instance handling 1.43 million operations per second for Redis SET workloads and 1.26 GB/s in static web serving throughput. For small-scale machine learning, inference for a 135M parameter language model registers 128.43 prompt tokens per second and 39.28 text generation tokens per second. Given its dedicated core allocation and balanced memory ratio, ecs.sn2ne.large is structured for light enterprise applications, development and testing environments, internal tools, and low-traffic web services where high computational throughput is not required.
